wins.text: Record total financing revenues across FICC & Equities grew at 15% CAGR since 2019 to nearly $8 billion in 2023; Q4 FICC financing hit a record $739M
Total AUS reached a record $2.8 trillion, representing 24th consecutive quarter of long-term fee-based net inflows; alternatives AUS at $295B
Surpassed $225B alternatives fundraising target one year ahead of schedule, reaching over $250B since 2020 Investor Day; guided to $40-50B in new alternatives raises for 2024
Full-year management and other fees of $9.5B on track to hit $10B target in 2024; alternatives management fees of $2.1B already surpassed $2B 2024 target
Returned $1.9B to shareholders in Q4 including $1B in buybacks at avg $311/share; achieved $600M run-rate payroll efficiency goal

risks.text: Full-year ROE of ~8% reported (10% adjusted for charges) well below mid-teens target; $2.8B reduction to net earnings from strategic exits and FDIC special assessment of $529M
FICC intermediation revenues down 24% YoY in Q4 to $2B, with activity particularly quiet in late November and December; full-year GBM revenues down 8%
Basel III Endgame regulatory uncertainty constraining capital return posture; CET1 at 14.5% but management cautious on buybacks pending rule resolution
CRE wholesale loan provisions driven by impairments roughly half related to CRE; office exposures marked at roughly 50% on prior calls
Platform Solutions consumer drag expected to persist into 2024, though materially reduced; Apple card partnership exit timeline and financial impact remain unquantified

guidance_items.detail: Management and other fees guided to hit $10B target in 2024, up from $9.5B in 2023; alternatives management fees already exceeded $2B 2024 target in 2023
Alternatives fundraising expected to be $40-50B in 2024; on-balance sheet HPI reduction to continue toward zero over medium term, though at slower pace than 2023's $13B
Efficiency ratio jumping-off point for 2024 cited as ~65% (adjusted), targeting 60% over time; Platform Solutions drag to be 'materially reduced' in 2024
Mid-teens ROE through-the-cycle target reaffirmed for both GBM and AWM segments; 25% AWM margin target reiterated
2024 effective tax rate guided to 22%-23%, up from 20.7% in 2023

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Apple card partnership exit financial impact and timeline
Lead Independent Director board governance transition following Bayo's firm sale to BlackRock
Basel III Endgame impact on specific ROTCE targets and business mix adaptation
